work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLXXVII (protocol LF47999–48002) commits to the bishop of Rimini faculties for daily Mass, sacraments and benediction in the oratory of his new episcopal college, and ends with its own 12 November 1833 closing at LF48070–48073, before numeral CCLXXVIII at LF48076. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF47999–47999; the source closing at LF48070–48073 reads: Datum Romaeapud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima secunda novembris mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno tertio. LF48040 3413 is the garbled page number 313. Its own provenance note 1 (Ex Bullario Romano., LF48110) is printed at the foot of leaf 331 inside CCLXXVIII's text and is excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
